cues: Some books add a third group, the secretory tissues.
Laticiferous tissue carries latex, in Euphorbia, Calotropis, Ficus and the rubber tree.
Glandular tissue includes nectaries, the oil glands of a lemon peel, the resin canals of pine and the digestive glands of the sundew.
